label: Winshall v. Viacom (Harmonix) — 3.5x the excess over a rising threshold, uncapped
provenance: PUBLIC RECORD. Winshall v. Viacom International Inc., Del. Ch. (2011), aff'd Del. (2013). The opinion states the selling stockholders 'became entitled to receive cash payments equal to three and a half times the excess, if any, over Gross Profit thresholds of $32 million in 2007 and $45 million in 2008.' The opinion does not disclose Harmonix's actual Gross Profit for either year or the amounts ultimately paid, so no figures are asserted here.

settled.note: The opinions do not state what was paid for either year.
